title: Backyard Barbecue: Smoker and Grill
servesOrScale: a shoulder, sausages and sides for about twelve
notes: An eleven-hour cook whose whole second half is anchored on the moment the pork goes into the cooler (event=start on a variable rest). The wrapped smoke and the cooler hold are both variable; the beans are indefinite (they tick over until service); service is a manual gate on the cooks' call, placed after the table is laid so it resolves against that step.
